div.div:
Suzuki Iruma and all thirteen students of the Misfit Class must perform to reach Rank 4 at the Music Festival.
(Source: Crunchyroll News)
Tenkousaki no Seiso Karen na Bishoujo ga, Mukashi Danshi to Omotte Issho ni Asonda Osananajimi datta Ken

Seven years after making a childhood promise to always be friends, Hayato is reunited with his formerly tomboyish pal Haruki at a city high school–only now, Haruki has transformed into the girl every guy dreams about! While Haruki’s looks may have changed, with Hayato, she’s still the same pal he remembers. Despite years apart, their promise and feelings remain and deepen into something stronger.
(Source: Crunchyroll)
Otomege Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu 2

Office worker Leon has just been thrust into an otome game where women hold all the power. His only tool for survival is the knowledge gained from playing this game in his past life. But after befriending the heroine and villainess, and making a name for himself, his choices begin to warp the story beyond what he knows. Now, Leon is dragged into a conspiracy that could shake the entire kingdom.
(Source: Crunchyroll)

In a remote mountain village under the watchful eyes of two stone guardians, the young Yuru contentedly lives off the land while staying close to the only family he has left—Asa, his precious twin sister. Asa, meanwhile, carries out a mysterious “duty” on behalf of the village while locked in a cage. Why is Asa a prisoner? And what other secrets does Yuru’s otherwise idyllic home hide? (Source: Square Enix)
